request.notes: Two worlds in sequence (membrane, then the gliders anchor). Per world: level-0 simulation on the GPU in float64 (public parameters, no exam secret), encoder grid in float32 with data passed to jitted functions as arguments and compiled functions released between configs (round-4 lessons), certification on the pod CPUs. Deadlines inside job.sh: membrane stops starting configs 70 min and certifications 80 min after its start, gliders 25 / 30 min; worst case 2.0 h. No network or subprocess calls after setup. CPU smoke test passed: job.sh end to end at tiny size (B5_TINY=1) from a git archive of exactly these paths at the code commit ce1cb6925. Expected about 1.4 h.
request.purpose: Round-5 study bias2 (track 1): inductive-bias grid on raw level 0 of the phase-membrane world (4 fields), plus the gliders anchor at width 1 under the same judges; encoders N/L/U x halo 0/8 x width 1/2 x recon/closure/local law, 2 seeds, cross-fitted
request.setup:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH
uv venv -q -p 3.12 $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv && . $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -q 'jax[cuda12]==0.12.0.1' numpy==2.5.4 scipy==1.18.0
